entries.jp: {FFEE}メルフィを救い、ジャスティンを倒せ！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Save Melfie and defeat Justin!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:007D}ガーディアンよ、メルフィの座標に対しＳ攻撃だ！
entries.en: {v:007D}Guardians, launch an S-attack on Melfie's coordinates!

entries.jp: {v:007E}Ｓ攻撃‥何それ‥‥？
entries.en: {v:007E}S-attack... What's that...?

entries.jp: ここまでよ！覚悟しなさい！
entries.en: This is the end! Prepare yourself!

entries.jp: ‥‥あなただけは、{n}絶対に許さないんだから！
entries.en: ...You're the one I'll never forgive!

entries.jp: お前みたいな外道だけは、絶対に許さねぇ！{n}くたばりやがれ！
entries.en: Scum like you, I'll never forgive! Drop dead!

entries.jp: ‥‥メルフィの代わりに、{n}私が博士たちの仇をとる！
entries.en: ...In Melfie's place, I'll avenge the doctors!

entries.jp: この世界を滅ぼそうとした罪、{n}死んで償うがいい！
entries.en: For the crime of trying to destroy this world, atone{n}with your life!

entries.jp: {v:0080}くっくっくっ！{n}ガーディアンは、まだまだいるぞ？
entries.en: {v:0080}Heh heh heh! There are plenty more Guardians where{n}those came from!
{FFF6}{v:0058}Ngh... uuugh...

entries.jp: {v:007F}なっ、自爆させた！？{n}なんて、ヒドイことを！
entries.en: {v:007F}Wha-- he made it self-destruct?! How horrible!
{FFF6}...{v:004C}Ngh... uuugh...

entries.jp: {v:004D}メルフィさん、いま助けてあげる！
entries.en: {v:004D}Melfie-san, I'll save you right now!

entries.jp: {v:004E}お兄ちゃん、みんな！{n}これから私はメルフィさんを助ける事に集中するよ？
entries.en: {v:004E}Big Brother, everyone! I'm going to focus on saving{n}Melfie-san from now on, okay?

entries.jp: ・もう少しだけ待て
entries.en: ・Wait a little longer

entries.jp: ・頑張れ！
entries.en: ・Hang in there!

entries.jp: {v:004F}う、うん‥‥。{n}でも時間がないから、ちゃんと状況を見てね！
entries.en: {v:004F}O-okay... But we're running out of time, so keep an eye{n}on the situation!

entries.jp: {v:0052}くそっ！{n}ここまで来て、失敗などさせるか！{n}この世界の連中は全部殺してやるのだ！
entries.en: {v:0052}Damn it! I won't fail after coming this far! I'll kill every{n}last person in this world!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0060}ぅ‥‥身体の中が光で満たされていく‥‥。{n}これは‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0060}Ngh... My body is filling with light... This is...

entries.jp: {v:0061}メルフィさん‥‥助かったのね‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0061}Melfie-san... She's saved...

entries.jp: {v:0062}よかったぁ～！
entries.en: {v:0062}Thank goodneeess!

entries.jp: {v:0030}ジャスティン‥‥許さない！{n}‥‥よくも‥‥！
entries.en: {v:0030}Justin... I won't forgive you! ...How dare you...!

entries.jp: {v:0057}もう少しだから、頑張って！
entries.en: {v:0057}Just a little more, hang in there!

entries.jp: {v:0059}メルフィさん、がんばって‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0059}Melfie-san, hang in there...

entries.jp: {FFF6}{v:005A}う‥‥‥‥、うあああああああっ！
entries.en: {FFF6}{v:005A}Ngh... uaaaaaaaagh!

entries.jp: {v:005B}これって時空の歪みが‥‥大きく‥‥！？
entries.en: {v:005B}This is... the space-time distortion is... growing...?!

entries.jp: {v:005C}もうだめ！{n}抑えきれない！{p}{v:005D}きゃああああああっ！
entries.en: {v:005C}I can't! I can't hold it back!{p}{v:005D}Kyaaaaaah!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0055}ご‥‥ごめんね、メルフィさん‥‥。{n}助けて‥‥あげられなかった‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:0055}I'm... I'm sorry, Melfie-san... I couldn't... save you...

entries.jp: {v:0053}きゃああっ！
entries.en: {v:0053}Kyaaah!

entries.jp: {v:0054}ルイセちゃん！？
entries.en: {v:0054}Luise-chan?!

entries.jp: はっはっは！{n}効かない！効かないな！
entries.en: Hahaha! It doesn't work! Doesn't work at all!

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:005E}ぐ‥‥ぐぅ‥‥。{n}‥‥俺は‥‥故郷を‥‥救うんだ‥‥。{n}故郷をそのままに‥‥幸せの中に‥‥。
entries.en: ...{v:005E}Ngh... gnh... ...I'm going to... save my homeland... Keep my{n}homeland as it is... in happiness...

entries.jp: {FFF6}{v:005F}ジャスティン‥‥。
entries.en: {FFF6}{v:005F}Justin...
